data.body: AC amendment: Quarterly refactor must preserve monthly subcommand behavior and idempotency marker format. Require: (a) all existing monthly tests from task-1 and task-2 pass unmodified after refactor, (b) the idempotency HTML-comment marker format from task-2 is reused (not redefined) for quarterly — only kind= changes (kind=quarterly), (c) monthly and quarterly markers must use distinct period discriminators so they cannot collide on the tracking ticket. Taxonomy: cross_task_interference.
